about_the_game:
Dive into an independent 2D platform game that pays tribute to 90s classics while bringing a modern and personal touch. Developed by a gamer for gamers, this project combines familiar mechanics with new ideas to offer an original and polished experience.

A stylized Paris as playground

The adventure takes place in a reimagined Paris, rarely shown in video games. The capital takes on unique appearances through an artistic blend that combines cartoon aesthetics with realistic architectural details. Each setting has been designed to be both surprising and immersive, transforming the city into a true playground.

Unique and realistic animations

The heroine stands out with animations inspired by real movements, offering great fluidity. Certain actions, unusual in the genre, enrich movement: climbing along gutters, using architecture to one's advantage, or exploring the city's rooftops. These mechanics bring a sense of freedom to the platform experience.

Varied levels

The game offers diverse environments, ranging from exteriors to interiors, including nocturnal, snowy, or aerial atmospheres. Each level has been designed to renew gaming pleasure, with original and sometimes unexpected situations. The game's universe doesn't forget a touch of humor, discreet but present, which contributes to its identity.

An independent game made with passion

This project uses modern techniques while respecting the spirit of classic platform games. Conceived and developed by an enthusiast, it aims to offer an experience that is both familiar, surprising, and memorable.

  • OS: Linux 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel I5 7300 2,5 Ghz / AMD Ryzen 5 3500U
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce gtx 1060 6 giga / AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
